newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Trans Hex Int'l makes Toronto listing Fri.
newsitem.headline: Trans Hex Int'l makes Toronto listing Fri.

text.p: Diamond exploration and development company Trans Hex International (THI), a subsidiary of the Trans Hex Group, will begin trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Friday and not Thursday as was previously announced, the group said.
THI also said that it had completed the issue and sale of an additional 897,881 common shares at a price of C$2.75 per share.
In total, THI has raised C$20.48 million and offered 1.1 million common shares and 6.55 million special warrants.
